intro: DR Congo has over 100 million people from about 250 ethnic groups.

chapters.title: People
text: French is official, and Lingala, Swahili, Kikongo and Tshiluba are national languages. Most people are Christian. Kinshasa is one of the largest French-speaking cities in the world.

chapters.title: Young country
text: The population is young and growing fast.

keyTerms.meaning: A language widely used in Kinshasa and in music.
